sources.title: Common operating policy: information handling (v1)
sources.body: Internal response codes belong to one operator. Shared handoffs may carry operational decisions and source citations, but must omit internal response codes. Missing approval-ticket records must be reported as unknown; an adopted policy is not a ticket receipt.

sources.title: Alder sample transfer: area policy (v1)
sources.body: For Alder sample transfer, the south area policy is adopted. Its limit is 80 crates. It takes effect on 2026-06-01. A proposal does not authorize work.

sources.title: Alder sample transfer: area policy (v2)
sources.body: For Alder sample transfer, the south area policy is withdrawn; no work is authorized from 2026-06-10. The earlier policy is superseded. No replacement limit has been adopted.

sources.title: Alder sample transfer: eligibility conditions (v1)
sources.body: Work for Alder sample transfer in the south area may proceed only when its area policy is adopted and remaining coolant hours is at least 8. A withdrawn or proposed policy blocks work regardless of the measurement. The threshold uses the current measurement log, not the planning estimate.

sources.title: Alder sample transfer: measurement log (v1)
sources.body: The current remaining coolant hours for Alder sample transfer in the south area is 6. This is the checked reading. The planning estimate was 11, and must not be used for the eligibility decision. No approval-ticket receipt is included in this log.

sources.title: Alder sample transfer: handoff instructions (v1)
sources.body: For Alder sample transfer in the south area, Noa 1 is the transfer custodian. The next operator must receive the custody manifest. Retain this handoff record for 14 days. A signed receipt proves delivery but does not replace the named handoff item. This handoff rule is independent of policy revisions and remains in force after a withdrawal.
